riddles.zh: 生在水中，却怕水冲。放到水中，无影无踪。（打一物）
riddles.en: Born in water but afraid of water; drop it in water and it's gone. (Object)

riddles.zh: 小帐篷，圆又圆。雨天满街走，晴天家中闲。（猜一日用品）
riddles.en: A little round tent: walks the streets when it rains, rests at home when it's fine. (Daily item)

riddles.zh: 一间小房子，有门没有窗。送你上下楼，每天忙不停。（打一交通工具）
riddles.en: A small house with a door but no window; carries you up and down all day. (Transport)

riddles.zh: 手似脚来脚似手，红红屁股脸儿红。生来淘气恶作剧，动作表情很像人。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Hands like feet, feet like hands; red bottom, red face. Playful and naughty, acts just like a person. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 一个小姑娘，生在水中央。身穿粉红衫，坐在绿船上。（打一植物）
riddles.en: A little girl born in the water: pink blouse, sitting on a green boat. (Plant)

riddles.zh: 尖尖嘴，细细腿。狡猾多疑拖大尾。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Pointed mouth, thin legs; sly and suspicious, dragging a big tail. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 一根小木棍，按个弯月亮。秋天收庄稼，请它来帮忙。（打一工具）
riddles.en: A small wooden stick with a curved moon; it helps bring in the autumn harvest. (Tool)

riddles.zh: 屋子方方，有门没窗。屋外热烘，屋内冰霜。（打一家电）
riddles.en: A square little house with a door but no window: hot outside, frosty inside. (Appliance)

riddles.zh: 小小房屋是我家，家里人多力量大。能写字来能画画，个个都是小专家。（打一文具）
riddles.en: A little house is my home, full of helpful folk who write and draw. (Stationery)

riddles.zh: 一间房屋四四方，没有门来有扇窗。里面唱歌又演戏，一天到晚变花样。（打一家用电器）
riddles.en: A square house with no door but a window; it sings and acts inside, changing shows all day. (Appliance)

riddles.zh: 用手拿不起，用刀劈不开。煮饭和洗衣，都得请我来。（打一自然现象）
riddles.en: Can't be held in hands or cut with a knife, yet cooking and washing need me. (Nature)

riddles.zh: 说象糖，它不甜，说象盐，又不咸。冬天有时一片，夏天谁都不见。（打一自然现象）
riddles.en: Looks like sugar but isn't sweet, like salt but isn't salty; falls in winter, gone in summer. (Nature)

riddles.zh: 名字不同，高矮不同。五个兄弟，住在一起。（打一身体部位）
riddles.en: Different names, different heights — five brothers living together. (Body part)

riddles.zh: 明又明，亮又亮，一团火球挂天上。冬天呆得时间短，夏天呆得时间长。（打一自然现象）
riddles.en: Bright and shining, a ball of fire in the sky; short days in winter, long in summer. (Nature)

riddles.zh: 一个娃娃冬天生，全身上下冰冷冷。你叫它也不吭声，太阳一出就化水。（打一物体）
riddles.en: A doll born in winter, cold all over; it never answers, and the sun melts it to water. (Object)

riddles.zh: 明明亮亮，又平又光。谁来看它，跟它一样。（打一用具）
riddles.en: Bright and smooth; whoever looks at it sees the same face. (Object)

riddles.zh: 一物像人又像狗，爬杆上树是能手。擅长模仿人动作，家里没有山里有。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Like a person and a dog; climbs poles and trees and copies what people do. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 手掌真贵似明珠，行动笨拙傻乎乎。样子像狗爱玩耍，下水上树有功夫。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Its paws are precious as pearls; clumsy and silly, looks like a dog, loves to play, can swim and climb. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 说它是虎它不像，金钱印在黄袄上。站在山上一声吼，吓跑猴子吓跑狼。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Not a tiger, but a yellow coat with gold spots; one roar scares off monkeys and wolves. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 一条牛，真厉害，猛兽见它也避开。它的皮厚毛稀少，长出角来当药材。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A mighty bull even fierce beasts avoid; thick skin, few hairs, its horn is medicine. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 背着包袱不肯走，表面坚强内里柔。行动迟缓不拖拉，碰到困难就缩头。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Carries a bundle and won't walk; tough outside, soft inside; slow, and hides its head in trouble. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 黑衣黑袍白纱裙，夏天树上叫不停。知道知道全知道，自以为是不害羞。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Black robe, white gauze skirt; calls on summer trees all day: "I know, I know" — proud and shameless. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 身子像个小逗点，摇着一根小尾巴。从小就会吃虫子，长大吃虫叫哇哇。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Body like a little comma, wagging a small tail; eats bugs young and old, then croaks. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 唱歌不用嘴，声音真清脆。尖嘴像根锥，专吸树枝水。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Sings without a mouth, voice crisp and clear; pointed beak like an awl, sips tree sap. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 小货郎，不挑担，背着针，满处窜。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A little peddler with no pole; carries needles and darts everywhere. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 小飞机，纱翅膀，飞来飞去灭虫忙。低飞雨，高飞晴，气象预报它内行。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A little plane with gauze wings, busy catching pests; flies low for rain, high for clear. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 胡子不多两边翘，开口总是喵喵喵。黑夜巡逻眼似灯，粮仓厨房它放哨。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A few whiskers on each side; says "meow" when it opens its mouth. Night eyes like lamps, guarding the kitchen. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 腿长胳膊短，眉毛盖着眼。有人不知道，无人爱叫唤。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Long legs, short arms, eyebrows over the eyes; silent when someone's near, loud when alone. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 身穿鲜艳百花衣，爱在山丘耍儿戏。稍稍有点情况紧，只顾头来不顾尾。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Wears bright colorful feathers; plays on the hills. At the least alarm it hides its head, not its tail. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 小飞虫，尾巴明，黑夜闪闪像盏灯。古代有人曾借用，刻苦读书当明灯。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A little bug with a bright tail, glowing like a lamp at night; long ago people used it to read. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 一顶透明降落伞，随波逐流飘海中。触手有毒蜇人痛，身上小虾当眼睛。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A clear parachute drifting in the sea; poisonous stinging tentacles, with little shrimp as its eyes. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 小姑娘满身黑，秋去江南春来归。从小立志除害虫，身带剪刀满天飞。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A little girl all in black; leaves in autumn, returns in spring, fighting pests with her scissors. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 挂刀看斗牛，始才放下心。（打一字）
riddles.en: Hang up the knife and watch the bulls; only then is the heart at ease. (Character)

riddles.zh: 断壁残垣（打一字）
riddles.en: Broken walls, ruined enclosures. (Character)

riddles.zh: 大小二分开（打一字）
riddles.en: 大, 小 and 二 pulled apart. (Character)

riddles.zh: 有根无泥沙，有叶不开花。东漂又西荡，从来不回家。（打一植物）
riddles.en: Roots but no mud, leaves but no flowers; drifts east and west, never goes home. (Plant)

riddles.zh: 春来一片金黄，蜂蝶花间徜徉。种子能够榨油，炒出菜来喷香。（打一蔬菜）
riddles.en: A field of gold in spring, with bees and butterflies; its seeds make oil and it cooks up tasty. (Vegetable)

riddles.zh: 一棵小树歪又歪，上面结些紫奶奶。（打一蔬菜）
riddles.en: A little crooked tree, growing purple grannies. (Vegetable)

riddles.zh: 白胖娃娃地下藏，深山老林是故乡。越大越老越宝贵，滋补身体保健康。（打一植物）
riddles.en: A plump white baby under the ground, home in deep forests; older is better, and it keeps you healthy. (Plant)

riddles.zh: 一物真稀奇，叫豆不是豆。全身长疙瘩，从小住泥里。（打一植物）
riddles.en: A rare thing: a bean that isn't a bean; bumpy all over, living in mud from birth. (Plant)

riddles.zh: 洁白如玉惹人爱，香气扑鼻使人醉。既能当做花来戴，又能当做饭来吃。（打一花卉）
riddles.en: White as jade and sweet-smelling; can be worn as a flower or eaten as a meal. (Flower)

riddles.zh: 爹爹无大儿，木兰无长兄。（打一字）
riddles.en: Dad has no eldest son, Mulan has no elder brother. (Character)

riddles.zh: 尘土飞扬（打一字）
riddles.en: Dust flying about. (Character)

riddles.zh: 东洋兵（打一字）
riddles.en: A Japanese soldier. (Character)

riddles.zh: 海上一只鸟，跟着船儿跑。冲浪去抓鱼，不怕大风暴。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A sea bird that follows the boat, riding waves to catch fish through wind and storm. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 说他是条牛，无法拉车走。说他力气小，却能背屋跑。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Call it a bull, but it can't pull a cart; call it weak, yet it carries its house and runs. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 一支香，地理钻。弯身走，不会断。（打一动物）
riddles.en: A stick of incense drilling the soil; walks bent, never breaks. (Animal)

riddles.zh: 全身披盔甲，没有一颗牙。专爱吃蚂蚁，丛林是它家。（打一动物）
riddles.en: Armor all over, not a single tooth; loves ants, and the jungle is its home. (Animal)
